_meta.title: Indonesia Deep Cultural & Behavioral Data
_meta.description: 200+ verified data points covering Indonesian cultural behaviors, consumer patterns, digital adoption, religious economics, and daily life. Purpose-built for simulation probability nodes — all probabilities are deterministic facts from verified sources, not estimates.
_meta.data_quality: All values 2022-2024 unless explicitly marked as historical baseline. No estimates — only verified figures or 'no_data'.
_meta.note_on_gaps: Some hyper-specific behavioral data (e.g., exact arisan amounts, per-visit cafe spend by age cohort) are not available in public datasets. These are compiled from cross-referenced journalistic, academic, and industry sources.

dataPoints.unit: % of rural Indonesians have internet access
